profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Bloomberg
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
👋🏽 Hi, my name is Andy

🎓 I recently graduated with a Bachelor's of Science in Computer Science and I'm currently pursuing an Online Master's of Science in Computer Science with a specialization in Machine Learning

🌇 New Jersey native, with a passion for learning new skills and technologies that can advance the industry and your company

📚 This past summer I interned at TikTok for the Data Trust and Safety Team. Before that I interned at Autodesk working on a disaster recovery service for AWS services. I built and configured AWS Lambda functions in Java and invoked API endpoints to save & restore data to ensure business continuity. In the past, I've interned at NCR where I was able to hone my skills in front-end development by updating the UI/UX of a product's webpage to utilize React Typescript. I worked in a professional, Agile environment, ensuring that users could save their form information with input validation and auto-formatting, and have the software be the single source of truth across different layers.

💻 In the future I hope to build my own products.

🏐 In my free time, you can find me competing in various sports, playing music, and building new relationships.
